{{Top|leg}}
A '''Guild Master''' or '''guildmaster''' was the leader of a guild. [[Gilfrome]] was the guildmaster of the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]] on [[Barlok/Legends|Barlok]].<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> The guildmaster of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] was the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]].
